summary: A rebuilt server no longer shows old vulnerabilities from its replaced device record.

fixes.title: Replaced device records no longer count
fixes.text: When Defender keeps an older record of a rebuilt server beside the new one, the old record's vulnerabilities no longer count. An update missing only on the old record no longer shows.

fixes.title: These findings never read as fixed
fixes.text: Such findings close as report changed, with a plain reason, so your ticketing system never records a fix that was not confirmed.
